Software Engineer (MTS / SMTS / LMTS), AI Runtime Platform
The role
Build the inference platform behind Salesforce’s AI agents.
Behind every Salesforce AI agent is a model, and behind every model is infrastructure that has to be fast, cheap, and secure. We’re building the Kubernetes-based platform that serves those models: a large and fast-growing fleet of custom models handling massive volumes of LLM traffic across multiple public clouds. You’ll join the Hyperforce Container Platform (HCP) team and build the layer beneath the models: GPU scheduling, distributed inference, and model serving.
This role is for engineers who want their code in the serving path of nearly every agentic request. You’ll work in the open-source ecosystem that the AI industry runs on, and make it production-grade for enterprise requirements: reliability, security, and strict tenant isolation.

Build the inference platform. Design and build core capabilities on Kubernetes: GPU scheduling, distributed model serving, and intelligent request routing.
Scale the LLM runtime. Support both inference and training with high-throughput serving and distributed multi-GPU execution.
Make shared GPUs a multi-tenant service. Drive inference performance and cost efficiency at fleet scale, with strong tenant isolation.
Treat AI as a first-class workload. Secure and operate it on the same service mesh, workload identity, and caching layer as every other Salesforce service.
Build the agentic runtime layer. Work on multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, and evaluation for accuracy and safety.
Isolate untrusted workloads. Build sandboxing for AI agents and the code they generate, keeping production workloads separated from each other.
Own reliability end to end. Run services to a 99.99% availability SLA, and make the platform observable and self-healing at fleet scale.
Shape the open-source foundations. Contribute upstream to vLLM, llm-d, Ray, and Kueue, Agent Substrate, and influence their direction and roadmaps.

Have strong software engineering experience, with hands-on depth in distributed systems and production service ownership
Have proven experience developing with AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot): you know how to direct them, review their output critically, and ship reliable code with them in your daily workflow
Know Kubernetes well and have built controllers or operators using Go. Istio/Envoy mesh experience is a plus.
Have built or operated services on a major public cloud (AWS or GCP)
Have worked with managed AI platforms for training and inference, such as AWS SageMaker or Google Vertex AI
Write Go fluently
Have worked on AI/ML model serving, model training or agentic systems, and can reason about the architecture, cost, and quality of what you build
Treat reliability as a design principle: observability, SLOs, and self-healing are built in from the start
Hold a degree in a related technical field
Even better if you
Have used inference and orchestration stacks such as vLLM, llm-d, Ray, or Kueue
Have hands-on experience with GPU scheduling, CUDA, or inference performance tuning
Know networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS termination
Have used Terraform and Argo, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or Elasticsearch
Have built multi-agent or RAG systems, or worked with knowledge graphs and LLM-as-judge evaluation
Have contributed to open-source projects upstream
